import sys,random,heapq,copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from exactcal import calibrate
from exactfabric import Calendar
from exactreplay import replay
random.seed(2016)

def slow(profile,f,g,tr):
    c=calibrate(profile);cal=Calendar(profile,f,c)
    n=f['n'];P=cal.p;T=cal.t;R=tr['rounds']
    clock=[None]*n;bound=[None]*n;gen=[0]*n
    peak=0;ak=True;adopts=delivers=uk=stale=0
    live=[];ss=[None]*len(tr['sends']);states={}
    for now in range(R*T+1):
        tick=now//T
        if now%T==0:
            for tk,i in tr['reboots']:
                if tk==tick:gen[i]+=1;clock[i]=None;bound[i]=None
            for i,a,b in f['anchors']:
                if a<=tick%P<b:clock[i]=0;bound[i]=0
            best={};ad=[None]*n
            for packet in live[:]:
                if packet['app']!=now:continue
                delivers+=1
                src,dst=packet['src'],packet['dst']
                if gen[src]!=packet['sg'] or gen[dst]!=packet['dg']:stale+=1
                elif packet['e'] is None:uk+=1
                elif dst not in best or (packet['b'],packet['id'])<(best[dst]['b'],best[dst]['id']):best[dst]=packet
                live.remove(packet)
            for dst,pack in best.items():
                if bound[dst] is None or pack['b']<bound[dst]:
                    clock[dst]=pack['e'];bound[dst]=pack['b'];ad[dst]=pack['id'];adopts+=1
            if any(x is None for x in clock):ak=False
            peak=max([peak]+[abs(x) for x in clock if x is not None])
            states[tick]={'bounds_as':bound.copy(),'errors_as':clock.copy(),'generations':gen.copy(),'adopted':ad}
            occupied=set()
            for idx in sorted(range(len(tr['sends'])),key=lambda i:tr['sends'][i][0]):
                id,tik,code,jit=tr['sends'][idx]
                if tik!=tick:continue
                lid,dir=divmod(code,2);ln=f['links'][lid]
                src,slot,a=ln['ends'][dir];dst,_,b=ln['ends'][1-dir]
                d=ln['delay_ns'][dir];defer=ln['defer_rounds'][dir]
                pos=(f['offset_ns']+tick*T)%f['slice_ns']
                sl=(f['offset_ns']+tick*T)//f['slice_ns']%len(f['slices'])
                blackout=False
                for dt in range(d):
                    phase=(tick+dt//T)%P
                    if any(l==lid and a<=phase<b for l,a,b in f['blackouts']):blackout=True
                if lid not in f['slices'][sl]:s='not_in_slice'
                elif blackout:s='blackout'
                elif pos<g or pos+d+g>f['slice_ns']:s='guard'
                elif (src,slot) in occupied:s='port_busy'
                else:
                    occupied.add((src,slot));s='lost' if id in tr['lost'] else 'sent'
                    if s=='sent':
                        e=clock[src];bo=bound[src]
                        if e is not None:
                            e+=(tr['bias_ps'][b]-tr['bias_ps'][a])*10**6+jit-(c['upper_ps'][a][b]-c['upper_ps'][b][a])*500000
                            bo+=(c['upper_ps'][a][b]+c['upper_ps'][b][a])*500000+(profile['jitter_ps'][a]+profile['jitter_ps'][b])*10**6
                        live.append({'id':id,'src':src,'dst':dst,'sg':gen[src],'dg':gen[dst],'e':e,'b':bo,'rx':now+d,'app':now+((d+T-1)//T+defer)*T})
                ss[idx]=s
        if now==R*T:break
        for i in range(n):
            if clock[i] is not None:
                clock[i]+=tr['rates_ppb'][tick][i]
                bound[i]+=cal.rates[i][tick%P]
                peak=max(peak,abs(clock[i]))
        for packet in live:
            if packet['rx']<=now and packet['e'] is not None:
                packet['e']+=tr['rates_ppb'][tick][packet['dst']]
                packet['b']+=cal.rates[packet['dst']][tick%P]
    return {'status':'ok','states':[states[t] for t in tr['queries']],'send_status':ss,'delivered':delivers,'adopted':adopts,'unknown_payloads':uk,'stale_payloads':stale,'pending':len(live),'peak_known_abs_as':peak,'always_known':ak}

for case in range(1000):
    n=random.randrange(2,6);P=random.randrange(1,7);T=random.randrange(1,6)
    pf={'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[2,3],'measurements':[[0,1,-4,7]]}
    f={'n':n,'interval_ns':T,'slice_ns':P*T,'offset_ns':random.randrange(P*T),'drift_ppb':[random.randrange(10) for _ in range(n)],'heat':[],'anchors':[], 'links':[],'slices':[[]],'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[0], 'reconfig_ns':0}
    for _ in range(random.randrange(10)):
        a=random.randrange(n);st=random.randrange(P);en=random.randrange(st+1,P+1)
        f['heat'].append([a,st,en,random.randrange(5)])
    for _ in range(random.randrange(1,6)):
        a=random.randrange(n);st=random.randrange(P);en=random.randrange(st+1,P+1)
        f['anchors'].append([a,st,en])
    for a in range(n):
        for b in range(a+1,n):
            if random.randrange(4)==0:continue
            lid=len(f['links'])
            f['links'].append({'ends':[[a,b,a%2],[b,a,b%2]],'delay_ns':[random.randint(1,8*T),random.randint(1,8*T)],'defer_rounds':[random.randrange(9),random.randrange(9)]})
            f['slices'][0].append(lid)
            if random.randrange(3)==0:
                st=random.randrange(P);en=random.randrange(st+1,P+1)
                f['blackouts'].append([lid,st,en])
    R=random.randrange(30)
    cal=Calendar(pf,f,calibrate(pf))
    bias=[random.randrange(-100,100)];bias+=[bias[0]+random.randrange(-4,8)]
    tr={'rounds':R,'rates_ppb':[[random.randint(-cal.rates[i][tick%P],cal.rates[i][tick%P]) for i in range(n)] for tick in range(R)],'bias_ps':bias,'sends':[],'lost':[],'reboots':[],'queries':[random.randrange(R+1) for _ in range(20)]}
    if f['links'] and R:
        for _ in range(random.randrange(100)):
            id=len(tr['sends']);tick=random.randrange(R);code=random.randrange(2*len(f['links']))
            tr['sends'].append([id,tick,code,random.randrange(-4000000,4000001)])
            if random.randrange(5)==0:tr['lost'].append(id)
        random.shuffle(tr['sends'])
    tr['reboots']=[list(x) for x in set((random.randrange(R+1),random.randrange(n)) for _ in range(random.randrange(10)))]
    got=replay(pf,f,0,tr);expect=slow(pf,f,0,tr)
    assert got==expect,(case,got,expect,f,tr)
print('random replay compared against nanosecond simulation OK')
